chapter.li: LEChapter31 Verse1 And now I, Nephi, make an end of my prophesying unto 2PP you, my beloved brethren. And I cannot write but a few things which I know must surely come to pass, neither can I write but a few of the words of my brother Jacob. VerseEnd Verse2 Wherefore, the things which I have written sufficeth me, save it be a few words which I must speak concerning the doctrine of Christ. Wherefore, I shall speak unto 2PP you plainly, according to the plainness of my prophesying. VerseEnd Verse3 For my soul delighteth in plainness, for after this manner doth the Lord God work among the children of men. For the Lord God giveth light unto the understanding, for he speaketh unto men according to their language, unto their understanding. VerseEnd Verse4 Wherefore, I would that 2PP ye should remember that I have spoken unto 2PP you concerning that prophet which the Lord shewed unto me that should baptize the Lamb of God, which should take away the sin of the world. VerseEnd

Verse5 And now, if the Lamb of God, he being holy, should have need to be baptized by water to fulfill all righteousness, oh, then, how much more need have we, being unholy, to be baptized, yea, even by water? VerseEnd Verse6 And now I would ask of 2PP you, my beloved brethren, wherein the Lamb of God did fulfill all righteousness in being baptized by water? VerseEnd Verse7 Know 2PP ye not that he was holy? But notwithstanding he being holy, he sheweth unto the children of men that according to the flesh he humbleth himself before the Father, and witnesseth unto the Father that he would be obedient unto him in keeping his commandments. VerseEnd Verse8 Wherefore, after he was baptized with water, the holy ghost descended upon him in the form of a dove. VerseEnd Verse9 And again, it sheweth unto the children of men the straitness of the path and the narrowness of the gate by which they should enter, he having set the example before them. VerseEnd Verse10 And he said unto the children of men, Follow 2PSI thou me. Wherefore, my beloved brethren, can we follow Jesus save we shall be willing to keep the commandments of the Father? VerseEnd Verse11 And the Father said, Repent 2PP ye, repent 2PP ye, and be baptized in the name of my Beloved Son. VerseEnd Verse12 And also the voice of the Son came unto me, saying, He that is baptized in my name, to him will the Father give the holy ghost like unto me. Wherefore, follow me and do the things which 2PP ye have seen me do. VerseEnd Verse13 Wherefore, my beloved brethren, I know that if 2PP ye shall follow the Son with full purpose of heart, acting no hypocrisy and no deception before God, but with real intent, repenting of 2PP your sins, witnessing unto the Father that 2PP ye are willing to take upon 2PP you the name of Christ by baptism — yea, by following 2PP your Lord and Savior down into the water according to his word — behold, then shall 2PP ye receive the holy ghost. Yea, then cometh the baptism of fire and of the holy ghost, and then can 2PP ye speak with the tongue of angels and shout praises unto the Holy One of Israel. VerseEnd

Verse14 But behold, my beloved brethren, thus came the voice of the Son unto me, saying, After 2PP ye have repented of 2PP your sins, and witnessed unto the Father that 2PP ye are willing to keep my commandments by the baptism of water, and have received the baptism of fire and of the holy ghost, and can speak with a new tongue — yea, even with the tongue of angels — and after this should deny me, it would have been better for 2PP you that 2PP ye had not known me. VerseEnd Verse15 And I heard a voice from the Father saying, Yea, the words of my beloved are true and faithful. He that endureth to the end, the same shall be saved. VerseEnd Verse16 And now my beloved brethren, I know by this that unless a man shall endure to the end in following the example of the Son of the living God, he cannot be saved. VerseEnd Verse17 Wherefore, do the things which I have told 2PP you I have seen that 2PP your Lord and 2PP your Redeemer should do; for, for this cause have they been shewn unto me: that 2PP ye might know the gate by which 2PP ye should enter. For the gate by which 2PP ye should enter is repentance and baptism by water, and then cometh a remission of 2PP your sins by fire and by the holy ghost. VerseEnd Verse18 And then are 2PP ye in this straight and narrow path which leads to eternal life. Yea, 2PP ye have entered in by the gate, 2PP ye have done according to the commandments of the Father and the Son, and 2PP ye have received the holy ghost, which witness of the Father and the Son unto the fulfilling of the promise which he hath made, that if 2PP ye entered in by the way, 2PP ye should receive. VerseEnd

Verse19 And now my beloved brethren, after 2PP ye have gotten into this straight and narrow path, I would ask if all is done. Behold, I say unto 2PP you, nay, for 2PP ye have not come thus far save it were by the word of Christ, with unshaken faith in him, relying wholly upon the merits of him who is mighty to save. VerseEnd Verse20 Wherefore, 2PP ye must press forward with a steadfastness in Christ, having a perfect brightness of hope, and a love of God and of all men. Wherefore, if 2PP ye shall press forward, feasting upon the word of Christ, and endure to the end, behold, thus saith the Father: 2PP Ye shall have eternal life. VerseEnd

Verse21 And now behold, my beloved brethren, this is the way; and there is none other way nor name given under Heaven whereby man can be saved in the kingdom of God. And now behold, this is the doctrine of Christ, and the only and true doctrine of the Father, and of the Son, and of the holy ghost, which is one God without end. Amen. VerseEnd
